result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane urban intersection that lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, creating a hostile environment for walking. While sidewalks are present, the large crossing distance and lack of dedicated pedestrian infrastructure prioritize vehicle throughput over safety.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted crosswalks, providing no designated space for pedestrians to cross the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane width of the street increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, high-speed urban arterial with multiple travel lanes and overhead highway-style signage. Despite the presence of sidewalks and a signalized intersection, there are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals, creating a highly hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible at the signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without guidance.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area in the center of the image

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The roadway is extremely wide, requiring pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without a refuge island.

hazards.name: High-speed road design
hazards.description: Wide lanes and overhead highway signage encourage high vehicle speeds, which increases the risk of severe injury in a collision.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide dedicated and predictable crossing phases.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages, reducing exposure time.

result.summary: The environment features a wide, multi-lane urban arterial with high-visibility crosswalk markings. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long crossing distance and lack of a pedestrian refuge island increase exposure to high-volume traffic.

hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Multiple Threat Potential
hazards.description: Multiple lanes in the same direction can lead to one car stopping while another in the adjacent lane continues, striking a pedestrian.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide urban intersection with standard pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, signals, and sidewalks. However, the environment is dominated by multi-lane vehicle traffic and lacks advanced safety features like refuge islands or curb extensions to mitigate the long crossing distance.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, significantly increasing their exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk spanning the entire width of the roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Large Vehicles
hazards.description: The presence of a large bus stopped near the intersection can block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers in adjacent travel lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection where the Drexel bus is positioned

interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicle traffic receives a green light.
